version.changelog: v2.1: 格式硬约束（强制编号列表、来源标注、可信度标记）；类别增至8个（白色家电独立）；新增正误示例对比，防止Agent自由发挥

llm.summary: This is a straightforward daily Chinese news digest skill that searches recent news and saves dated reports, with those behaviors disclosed and aligned with its purpose.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is daily news collection and report generation, and the artifact only directs the agent to calculate a date, perform freshness-limited news searches, filter sources, format results, and save the report.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are specific to eight news categories, source quality, freshness filtering, and report formatting; no credential requests, destructive commands, prompt overrides, or unrelated data access were found.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact set contains only a non-executable SKILL.md file; no scripts, binaries, package installs, or hidden install steps are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Use of web_search and a disclosed weekday 08:30 cron trigger is proportionate for a daily news automation skill, though users should know it may run automatically if that scheduled task is enabled.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill saves generated reports under memory/daily_news_{YYYY-MM-DD}.md and lists memory/daily_news_*.md as historical archives; this is persistent but narrowly scoped and disclosed.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this if you want an automated Chinese daily news digest and are comfortable with it using web search, potentially running on the disclosed weekday schedule, and keeping dated report archives in memory/. Disable or avoid the scheduled task if you only want manual reports or do not want retained archives.
llm.findings: [SQP-2] expected: The persistence concern is real as a privacy consideration, but the artifact explicitly shows the saved report path in the template, save step, and related-files table; the retained content is the generated daily news report rather than broad local/private data or credentials.
